name: web-raw
description: Minimal browser app instrumented with PostHog error tracking, using posthog-cli to inject chunk IDs and upload source maps (no bundler plugin). `start` is the published CLI on the normal release-binding path; `start:releaseless` is a locally-built CLI with --no-release-bind. posthog-js is vendored because only an unreleased build reads the injected release id.

scripts.start: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm process && node serve.mjs
scripts.start:releaseless: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm process:releaseless && node serve.mjs
